The '''2015 Wisconsin State Championship''' was a 22-player tournament on 27 June 2015 at The District Company, 305 S. Barstow St., Eau Claire, Wisconsin. [[Mark Walseth]] was tournament director, and Charlie won.<ref name="wisc15">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=954243#p954243 Wisconsin States - 2015 / Eau Claire, WI.], Walsetmd, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 June 2015). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122221058/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p954243.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="wisc-td" />

<gallery widths="300" heights="225">
File:2015 Wisconsin State Championship game room.jpg|The game room at The District Company
</gallery>

== Format ==

* '''Hours:''' 12:00–7:00, with an optional final confrontation from 7:00–9:00<ref name="wisc-ann" />
* '''Structure:''' six games of modified Swiss<ref name="wisc-ann" />
* '''Entry:''' $10<ref name="wisc-ann" />
* '''Field:''' 22 players (3 from Wisconsin, 1 from North Dakota, and 18 from Minnesota)<ref name="wisc15" />
* '''Set up by:''' Jeremy<ref name="wisc15" />
* '''Prizes:''' a box of Tatooine (30 packs), a trophy, a bye to Worlds, and the Max Rebo Award (five packs of Reflections III)<ref name="wisc-ann" />

== Results ==

Walseth posted these places.<ref name="wisc15" /> Charlie already had a bye, so Drew claimed the bye to Worlds.<ref name="wisc-puck">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=954216#p954216 Wisconsin States - 2015 / Eau Claire, WI.], puck71, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 June 2015). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122221058/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p954243.html Internet Archive]</ref>
